title: WOLF / Complete Assembly Tour
authorship: Original Mechanism Studio extended composition, deterministic synthesis and editorial effects. Established warm synthesis voices, one new complete arrangement. No third-party samples, service calls or recordings.
musicalFeel: Gentle keys, warm pads and restrained bass, continuous through whole assembly, motor, bearing and return. Two source-part close-ups receive quieter reading space. No drum bed, narration or label dings.
timing: One seekable 160-beat PCM buffer. Music voices and room tails span scene changes. All movement effects derive from the final global motion-event windows; no old segment PCM joins or chapter restarts. Gear and bearing rotations receive music only, without claimed contact recordings.

synthesis.origin: Exact reuse of the tour-v1 synthesis engine and voice palette, extending the same harmonic arc for two added mechanical views.

mix.effects: Quiet filtered-air movement textures and sparse completed-return accents. Editorial cues, not motor/bearing recordings or solved contact acoustics.

automation.method: Smooth continuous gain derived from the two actual out/return inspection pairs.

effects.clock: Baked into the same PCM buffer; no wall-clock timers.
effects.repetitionPolicy: One wave per source family and direction, grouping four actual angular batches; no per-piece click sequence.
